claims: Tax Day for 2026 is Wednesday, April 15, 2026.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to file federal income tax returns for the 2025 tax year.
April 15, 2026 is the deadline to pay any taxes owed to the IRS for the 2025 tax year.
Federal income tax returns must be filed or postmarked by April 15, 2026.
Form 4868 is filed by April 15, 2026 for an extension until October 15, 2026 to file.
Extensions to file are not extensions to pay.
Taxes owed must be paid by April 15, 2026 to avoid penalties.
